parts.label: main
parts.technique: Volume of solid of revolution by integration
parts.reason: The mark scheme requires finding the volume of a solid of revolution generated by rotating a region about the x-axis (π∫y²dx). This is a named concept ('solid of revolution'/volume of revolution) that is not mentioned in any P8 statement — P8.3 only covers area under a curve and area between curves, not rotation to form a volume. Per the rule, a named concept not mentioned anywhere in the statements makes the part OUT even though the underlying integration techniques (integrating a power function, subtracting areas) are themselves in spec.

parts.label: a
parts.technique: Rates/volume calculation using given formula and constant flow rate
parts.reason: This part only requires substituting h=20 into the given formula for V and dividing by the constant flow rate 160 to get a time — pure arithmetic/algebraic substitution using a given cubic-type formula and a constant flow rate; no excluded topic, basic modelling arithmetic supported generally by P7.6/contextual modelling statements.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: Connected rates of change (chain rule)
parts.reason: Requires dV/dh, then dV/dt = dV/dh × dh/dt, a standard connected rate of change problem explicitly covered by P7.4 guidance (dV/dt = dV/dr × dr/dt example).

parts.label: main

parts.reason: Uses substitution u=√x then partial fractions to integrate, matching P8.5 (integration by substitution) and P8.6 (partial fractions linear in denominator) exactly; evaluating a definite integral to a log form is standard.
